_comment: Ragdoll on the shared skeleton. Bodies are auto-fitted capsules (bone -> child bone, radius from the canonical mesh); override per body: radius, mass_frac, shape (capsule|box|sphere), half [x,y,z], friction, restitution. Joints: cone [normal, plane] deg + twist [min, max] deg for swing-twist, hinge [min, max] deg for knees / elbows (relative to the bind pose). Per-character size: 'ragdoll_scale' in assets/characters/*.json.
